title: SLIIT CodeFest 2026
organizerUniversity: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology
description: A 36-hour on-campus build sprint for SLIIT and open external teams, focused on practical software engineering over novelty. Judged by industry engineers from Colombo's product companies, with a strong emphasis on shipped, working demos.
whoCanParticipate: SLIIT students get priority; a limited number of external undergraduate teams are also accepted.
